claim.claim-text: 1. A protection circuit for an alternating current system including a transformer, the protection circuit comprising:

(i) monitor a measurement from the current measuring device to determine whether the alternating current is above a predetermined threshold; and (ii) based at least in part upon determining that the alternating current is above the predetermined threshold, closing the switch assembly, thereby forming an electrical path between a neutral of the transformer and a ground.
2. The protection circuit of claim 1, wherein the control module is further configured to, upon determining that the alternating current is above the predetermined threshold, generate an alarm.
3. The protection circuit of claim 1, wherein the control module is further configured to, upon determining that the alternating current is above the predetermined threshold, log an event.
4. The protection circuit of claim 1, wherein the switching assembly is movable between an open position and a closed position.
5. The protection circuit of claim 1, wherein the switching assembly is operable in a normally-closed position.

6. The protection circuit of claim 1, further comprising an overvoltage protection device connected in parallel with the DC blocking component and the switching assembly, and wherein the control module is further configured to:

7. The protection circuit of claim 1, wherein the control circuit is configured to close the switch assembly upon determining that the alternating current is above the predetermined threshold, for at least a predetermined amount of time.

8. The protection circuit of claim 7, wherein the control circuit is further configured to disable the protection mode in response to determining that the alternating current is above the predetermined threshold for at least the predetermined amount of time, and wherein upon disabling the protection mode, the control circuit is further configured to generate an alarm.
9. The protection circuit of claim 1, wherein the switch assembly is capable of breaking or interrupting direct current.
10. The protection circuit of claim 9, wherein the switch assembly comprises a DC switch.

11. The protection circuit of claim 1, wherein the control circuit is configured to close the switch assembly immediately upon determining that the alternating current is above the predetermined threshold.
12. A protection circuit for an alternating current system including a transformer, the protection circuit comprising:

(i) monitor a measurement from the voltage measuring device to determine whether the voltage is above a predetermined threshold; and (ii) upon determining that the voltage is above the predetermined threshold for at least a predetermined amount of time, closing the switch assembly, thereby forming an electrical path between a neutral of the transformer and a ground.

13. The protection circuit of claim 12, wherein the control module is further configured to, upon determining that the voltage is above the predetermined threshold for at least a predetermined amount of time, actuate the switching assembly from an open position to a closed position and generate an alarm.
14. The protection circuit of claim 12, wherein the voltage comprises a direct current voltage.
15. The protection circuit of claim 12, wherein the voltage comprises an alternating current voltage.
